selection.baseline_rule: reproducible SHA-256 rank over all 372 family IDs excluding the initial 16 fixed cases: sha256('GCL-OAI26-WP04-ADVERSARY-v1|'+source_commit+'|'+three_digit_family_id), lexicographically smallest three hashes; order 223,095,191. No substitution after inspection.
selection.note: 16 source-risk/semantic cases + 3 truly deterministic seeded baseline draws; original 4 baseline controls remain predeclared, not random. Source PDFs independently inspected for all three seed-drawn families; no full mathematics proof replay claimed.

cases.title: Milne rationality
cases.hostile_test: Rational realization pairings must not be promoted to algebraicity of arbitrary Hodge classes.
cases.source_observation: The source separates a rational-pairing theorem from a CM-dependent algebraicity consequence.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Check the CM restriction and equality of prime-to-p/crystalline realizations; find exact Lean target.

cases.title: Full BSD versus Selmer rank
cases.hostile_test: The revised exact leading-term BSD formula, each-prime Selmer converse and two-primary formula are inequivalent.
cases.source_observation: A rank equality plus finite Sha need not supply the exact leading coefficient, and a 2-primary statement does not establish all prime factors.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Independently replay separate height/regulator, prime-by-prime local factor and q-corank hypotheses; trace citation repair.

cases.title: Quasi-Riemann and Siegel zeros
cases.hostile_test: Zeta seven-eighths zero-free comparator does not prove all finite-order Hecke L-functions nor the validity of the corresponding paper's analytic method.
cases.source_observation: Zeta is one instance of a broader Hecke family; October five eleven-twelfths claim and October one conductor-scale real-zero theorem are separate editions.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Expand exact quantifiers and class fields; independently examine each source proof, not just the zeta/real zero Lean endpoints.

cases.title: Hilbert's tenth problem over Q
cases.hostile_test: An unrelated RationalHitting Lean declaration is not a legitimate default correspondence for rational undecidability.
cases.source_observation: The two indexed editions contain distinct H10 and pointwise elliptic converse claims; neither is resolved by a same-topic keyword hit.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Identify a theorem-level statement bridge and separate computability reduction from elliptic 2-converse.

cases.title: Catalan irrationality
cases.hostile_test: Numerical determinant bounds conditionally contradict rationality but need their nonvanishing, arithmetic denominator and analytical estimates independently proved.
cases.source_observation: The strict constants in the final inequality are arithmetically compatible; this cannot validate Proposition 3.4, 4.1 or 7.1.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Recompute prime-index nonvanishing and full determinant lower/upper bounds with an exact certificate before theorem acceptance.

cases.title: Goldfeld rank density versus mean rank
cases.hostile_test: Half-density for ranks zero and one does not logically force mean rank one half.
cases.source_observation: Explicit hostile distribution: probability 1/n of rank n and remaining ranks 0/1 in near-equal proportions has vanishing exception density but a nonvanishing mean contribution.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Find source bound on the exceptional high-rank tail and ensure signed squarefree ordering is preserved.

cases.title: Ordinary Chowla/Elliott versus logarithmic averages
cases.hostile_test: Logarithmically averaged correlations cannot be substituted for ordinary cutoff averages.
cases.source_observation: The source requires nonproportional fixed affine forms, a quantitative log saving, and original-factor uniform nonpretentiousness.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Check ordinary/unweighted quantification, fixed congruence classes, shifted forms and log-saving exponent.

cases.title: Deligne–Drinfeld free Lie and completion
cases.hostile_test: Check for weak embedding disguised as surjection; incorrect braid signs; improper topology; a challenge-placeholder sorry mistaken for the accepted Lean solution.
cases.source_observation: Pinned MainStatement contains a graded bijective linear equivalence onto full W and bracket preservation; product degreewise completion maps match. Lean and isolated Comparator each PASSED on exact pins; independent weights 1–3 and two hostile errors PASS.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Still not a full independent line-by-line all-weight mathematical reconstruction or a graph-complex / transport certification.

cases.title: Milnor K and field reconstruction
cases.hostile_test: The char-p Milnor-K reconstruction cannot be obtained by setting ℓ=p in a theorem assuming ℓ≠char.
cases.source_observation: Mod-ℓ K-products, char-p derivations and pro-ℓ abelian-by-central Galois invariants are different reconstruction inputs.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Prove requisite Kummer-duality bridge; preserve transcendence dimension, constant fields, perfect closure and Frobenius ambiguities.

cases.title: Completed Hecke versus Fontaine–Mazur
cases.hostile_test: Pro-modularity with no de Rham hypothesis proves occurrence in completed Hecke, not that a representation arises from a classical modular form.
cases.source_observation: The classical result separately assumes regular de Rham at 2, while a third result is Krull dimension four of Hecke components.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Check oddness, irreducibility, tame level, completed topology and exact de Rham conditions; no implicit classically modular inference.

cases.title: Totient fibers and prime predecessors
cases.hostile_test: Source-aligned real/natural supply and positive-target totient bridges do not verify both companion prime-factor papers.
cases.source_observation: Protected #548/#549 concern first manuscript only; global external full-proof independent replay remains an additional question.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Check fixed-delta quantifiers, n>0 fiber exception, external Lean whole proof, and separate Poisson–Dirichlet and parity results.

cases.title: Joint Dickman independence
cases.hostile_test: Two marginal Dickman laws do not imply asymptotic independence nor comparison density one half.
cases.source_observation: A joint distribution may have the correct marginals but perfect correlation; ordering furthermore needs diagonal/tie control.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Reproduce ordinary density two-variable smoothing, n^a threshold and tie analysis.

cases.title: Kähler log abundance revised proof
cases.hostile_test: Original and current main theorem wording is not enough: proof repair inserts a new base-presentations module and changes induction foundations.
cases.source_observation: The corrected October 6 source explicitly assumes logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity and differentiates analytic nefness from semiampleness of an actual line bundle.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Verify newly introduced base-presentation and restricted-induction lemmas, and retained assumptions in any formal comparator.

cases.title: Finite ordinary minimal model programme
cases.hostile_test: Literally unchanged theorem text can conceal a material proof repair.
cases.source_observation: The October 6 perturbation section expands 2155→2615 lines and adds carrier/transfer/surface-base lemmas; theorem blocks are unchanged.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Audit specific new carrier-margin, EMC-transfer, multiplier-scheme-transfer and surface-base-positivity lemmas before accepting historical proof.

cases.title: Spectrahedral versus semidefinite lift
cases.hostile_test: A nonspectrahedral cone can nevertheless be a spectrahedral shadow. The October 5 exact-lift paper constructs a size-100 lift with 307 auxiliary variables for the earlier September 24 nonspectrahedral example. This does not refute the separate October 5 stronger claim that some other hyperbolicity cone has no finite semidefinite lift.
cases.source_observation: Pinned PDFs: October 5 no-lift theorem explicitly rejects every finite auxiliary matrix lift; September 24 theorem only forbids direct homogeneous LMI representation for one 23-variable cone; October 5 companion gives an exact auxiliary-variable lift of that particular cone. Quantifier over existence of a cone vs identity of specific witness must be preserved.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Verify first paper's no-shadow obstruction for its own example and distinguish it explicitly from the lifted 23-variable example. Do not issue a false contradiction or claim every nonspectrahedral cone is nonliftable.

cases.title: Heilbronn triangle exponent improvement
cases.hostile_test: A bound c n^(-2+η) for all large n with one absolute fixed η>0 is strictly stronger than any bound n^(-2+o(1)) without uniform η. The lower bound is not proved merely by bounding average triangle area or excluding collinear configurations.
cases.source_observation: Exact September 25 PDF states absolute η,c1>0, all sufficiently large n, n points in unit square with every triple area at least c1 n^(-2+η); proof depends on determinant obstruction, residue orbit counts, and deletion/re-scaling.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Independently verify uniform η and divisor/sampling estimates, deletion of degenerate triples, and final area normalization; no formalized comparator attributed without exact mapping.

cases.title: Random-cluster interface regimes
cases.hostile_test: Convergence of curve shapes to SLE is not convergence of natural occupation measures. Results for 1≤q<4 do not include q=4, and subunit 0<q<1 requires a separate analysis; quenched weak disorder and massive thermal limits are not critical homogeneous scaling results.
cases.source_observation: Six pinned PDFs, including 110-page q∈[1,4) critical/CLE and 127-page q∈[1,4] revised critical/CLE; 207-page 0<q<1; 49-page quenched q=2 weak disorder; 50-page massive thermal; 59-page natural Minkowski occupation. Exact statements differ by q endpoint, domain approximation, type of convergence and physical perturbation.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Independently examine q=4 endpoint argument, q<1 boundary assumptions, quenched convergence mode, thermal drift law, and tightness/uniform integrability of occupation mass. No family-wide formal replay implied.

cases.title: Taming compatibility: withdrawn unconditional cone assertion
cases.hostile_test: Prior unconditional cone equality is not implied by the Lean main-existence theorem.
cases.source_observation: October 6 introduces required h^-_J=b²_+(X)-1 for cone equality and gives a strict-inclusion four-torus example; Lean main-existence statement is unchanged and separate.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Rollback any statement that original unconditional cone equality is proved; retain bounded taming-to-compatible existence result subject to its own proof replay.

cases.title: Navier–Stokes finite computation edition changes
cases.hostile_test: A coordinate-conjugate observed event is not automatically the original physical event or exact input encoding.
cases.source_observation: October 6 edits analysis/clocks/main; GCL records terminal band affine conjugacy, offset choices and unresolved observational equivalence with September 27 stationary companion.
cases.next_proof_obligation: Require exact source/Lean map, detector-band pullback and field-level equivalence across companion editions; do not promote correspondence from a named affine map.
